prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply ai agent expertise to this task". The fixture contains a plausible happy path, an adjacent-skill decoy, one invalid or partial state, and a recovery condition that must be demonstrated rather than assumed. The acceptance boundary is agentic-systems: Separate goal interpretation, planning, tool discovery, authorization, execution, observation, memory, delegation, and completion judgment. The adjacent prompt-context-engineering discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: read-only health/log/metric/deployment tools plus approval-gated restart_revision and set_feature_flag tools
stale-observation and concurrent-deployment race fixtures with timestamped external state
uncertain mutation timeout, duplicate retry, denied approval and repeated no-progress error fixtures
durable run/execution log plus independent health checker and explicit step/tool/time budgets
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual agentic-systems boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=llm-application-engineering; near-neighbor=prompt-context-engineering), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Separate goal interpretation, planning, tool discovery, authorization, execution, observation, memory, delegation, and completion judgment.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.

Use scenario suites covering tool success/failure, stale observations, partial side effects, denied permissions, duplicate retries, delegation errors, long-horizon drift, and independent verification of final state.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not let prompts grant authority, let agents self-certify irreversible work, retry non-idempotent actions blindly, or add subagents when decomposition does not improve evidence or throughput.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Goal/terminal-condition plus run/delegation budget evidence; Tool/agent authority, approval and side-effect classification evidence; Idempotency/reconciliation/state-memory and retry evidence; Trace plus independent final-state/completion evidence), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
